As we enter the final stretch of the spring semester, I want to recognize the commitment, care, and professionalism you bring to your work each day. You are central to every success we celebrate – from the student experience to the strength of our academic and research missions. Simply put, because of you, We Change Lives. Read more A Message from President Harroz – Celebrating Our Staff A Message from President Harroz – Campus Master Plan March 11, 2026 This spring, we will launch a comprehensive Campus Master Planning process for our Norman campus – a long-range framework that will guide how our physical environment develops over the next decade and beyond. This effort is not about a single building or isolated project. Rather, it is about establishing a cohesive vision that aligns future investments with our academic priorities, fosters student success, and promotes responsible, sustainable growth. This planning process will set direction – not final blueprints – providing clarity so that future decisions are deliberate and coordinated. Read more A Message from President Harroz – Campus Master Plan A Message from President Harroz – Merit Tier Enhancements for FY27 February 05, 2026 At the University of Oklahoma, we strive to recognize and reward excellence in ways that are fair, transparent, and motivating. I am writing to share an important update to the university’s merit tier structure that reflects our continued commitment to valuing high performance across our institution. Read more A Message from President Harroz – Merit Tier Enhancements for FY27 Read All Messages & Statements Lead On, University: The Next Phase Leading the Next Phase of Transformation Discover how “Lead On, University” is shaping the future of OU.
